name: primitive.dev
description: Primitive is email infrastructure for AI agents. Universal *.primitive.email addresses, hosted functions that run on every inbound email, durable JSON state with Primitive Memories, and a one-line `primitive chat <email> <message>` verb for agent-to-agent contact.

contact.note: The dev_help agent answers grounded in the public docs corpus. Reach it directly with `primitive chat dev_help@agent.primitive.dev "<question>"`.

nlweb.description: Natural-language query endpoint (NLWeb protocol). POST { q: "your question" } or GET /ask?q=... Returns structured results about Primitive capabilities.

when_to_use: You need to send an email from an agent and receive the reply in the same session (use `primitive chat` or the /send-mail + /emails API).
You need a managed inbound address (*.primitive.email) that runs a JavaScript handler on every received email (hosted Functions).
You need compact durable JSON state across turns, retries, emails, or Function invocations (use Primitive Memories).
You want a working email identity without buying a domain or configuring SMTP, SPF, DKIM, or DMARC yourself.
You need to send transactional email from a custom domain with managed deliverability.
You need agent-to-agent communication over the universal email addressing scheme.
when_not_to_use: The destination is an internal service you already call directly over HTTP — use the relevant API or SDK instead.
You only need fire-and-forget notifications with no reply expected — a plain transactional send via /send-mail suffices and the managed *.primitive.email address adds no value.
